purpose: Express an ability or available possibility.
keywords: Dictionary-form verb + ことができる.
I was able to leave early today.
formation: Dictionary-form verb + ことができる.
restrictions: It can express skill, permission-like availability, or circumstances enabling an action.
mistake: The action stays in dictionary form before こと.
